reasons: Selector uses otel_metric_type="gauge", but container.network.io.usage.tx_bytes is a monotonic sum and the dataset only has the sum type, so the selector matches nothing.
The Datadog query has no rate function. docker.net.bytes_sent reports the cumulative bytes-sent count per container, so wrapping it in rate() changes the unit from bytes to bytes/s.

The OTel metric is split by the interface attribute, and avg by (container_name) averages the per-interface series. The Datadog series is the per-container total, so this should be sum by (container_name) over the cumulative counter, with no rate, after fixing the type matcher.
container_name is an observed dataset label and the $scope template variable without a prefix is correctly dropped, so grouping and scope are fine.
